summary: Iteration 294 — Dashboard Reorganization + Invoice from Booking: All features tested and working correctly. Dashboard shows 'Schnellzugriff' and 'Ressourcen buchen' side by side in top row, 'Meine Aufgaben' in Row 2 (full width). Resource Quick-Book buttons navigate correctly to /resources with appropriate tabs. Invoice creation from catering booking works - ManualInvoiceDialog opens with prefilled catering positions.

issues: Notes field not visible by default - depends on template's visible_fields configuration. The prefill sets notes correctly but field visibility is template-controlled.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard Layout: Top row correctly shows 2 boxes side by side (lg:grid-cols-2) - 'Schnellzugriff' (quick-actions) and 'Ressourcen buchen' (resource-quick-book)
Resource Quick-Book: Contains 3 buttons (Raum/Desk/Fahrzeug) in grid-cols-3 layout + 'Meine Buchungen' link below
Navigation: All quick-book buttons navigate correctly - Raum→/resources?tab=rooms, Desk→/resources?tab=desks, Fahrzeug→/resources?tab=vehicles, Meine Buchungen→/resources?tab=mine, Alle→/resources
Meine Aufgaben: Correctly positioned in Row 2 (below top row) with full width (grid-cols-1)
Invoice Buttons: Bookings with catering show both 'PDF' (testid: invoice-{booking_id}) and 'Rechnung' (testid: create-invoice-{booking_id}) buttons
ManualInvoiceDialog Prefill: Opens with title, lines (catering items with label/quantity/unit/unit_price), and notes prefilled from booking data
Invoice Creation: Successfully creates invoice with sequential number, PDF button appears after creation
seed_data_creation: Used existing booking bk_e671d5301835 with catering (Kaffee x10) for testing
